notes: This portable C++ TCK contract checks negotiated ownership transfer through ConfirmDivestiture and the corresponding standard HLAreportServiceInvocation interaction. The adapter supplies the provider package, multi-attribute FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration. The owner requests negotiated divestiture, the requester acquires the attribute, and the owner confirms divestiture with a distinct tag. The scenario verifies the ownership-confirmation callback flow, resulting ownership, reliable receive-order MOM delivery, the ConfirmDivestiture service identity/type/success, all eight standard report parameters, typed object/attribute/tag arguments, the null return marker, empty exception, and initial serial value. The source uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador/FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM data elements, and the C++ standard library; it makes no provider-specific or implementation-state assertion.

api_surfaces.owner: IEEE 1516.1 C++ API and IEEE 1516.2 standard MIM
